_doc: MetaForge map space (x = lng, y = lat) -> pixel space of RaidTheory/arcraiders-data map images at max zoom: image_px = scale * map + (tx, ty). Uniform scale, no rotation, no y flip. Tiled maps: 512 px tiles, {z}/{x}/{y}.webp with x = column, y = row; full image is 1000 * 2^z px square (z0-1 under v2/low, z2-3 under v2/high; edge tiles are cropped). At zoom z divide scale, tx, ty by 2^(3-z). Residuals are in max-zoom image px. See docs/research/map-images.md (2026-10-04).
